en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large, elegant multi‑storey hotel complex labeled "Hôtel Trento," set against mountainous scenery. The buildings form a U‑shaped frontage with many windows, balconies, arcades, and an entrance courtyard. Trees occupy the left foreground, and mountains dominate the hazy background. Printed captions in red identify the location and hotel. A handwritten message in Italian appears across the bottom.
